info.title: distribute.you MCP Service
info.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for distribute.you. Exposes campaign management tools via MCP protocol over HTTP.

distribute_status.description: Check the connection and say who the key belongs to: the user, and every organization the key reaches with its brands. A key belongs to its USER and reaches every organization that user is a member of; it never belongs to a brand and never carries staff or beta powers. Call this first: the other tools take a brandId (and an orgId when a brand sits in several organizations) from this list. Keys are created and revoked at https://dashboard.distribute.you and sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

distribute_list_workflows.description: List all available workflows. Includes styled workflows written in the style of industry experts (e.g. Hormozi). Call distribute_status first to list brands, then pass brandId (and orgId if a brand sits in several orgs). A user in a single organization can omit both.

human_id.description: Filter by human expert ID (for styled workflows)

brandId.description: Brand to act on (from distribute_status). Selects the organization holding it. Required when your key reaches several organizations, unless orgId is given.

orgId.description: Organization to act in (from distribute_status). Add it when a brand sits in several organizations, or to act in an organization without naming a brand.

distribute_list_campaigns.description: List the cold email campaigns of one brand or organization. Call distribute_status first to list brands, then pass brandId (and orgId if a brand sits in several orgs). A user in a single organization can omit both.

brandId.description: Brand to act on (from distribute_status). Selects the organization holding it. Required when your key reaches several organizations, unless orgId is given.

orgId.description: Organization to act in (from distribute_status). Add it when a brand sits in several organizations, or to act in an organization without naming a brand.

status.description: Filter by campaign status. `ongoing` is the vocabulary the platform stores — an unrecognised value is not refused, it is ignored, and the whole list comes back.

distribute_campaign_stats.description: Get one campaign's results. Report meetings, positive replies and delivery rate first, then volume and cost; bounces and other failures last. The response is ordered that way: `headline`, then `summary`, then the raw figures, then `failureDetails`. Show zeros plainly (0 meetings is still reported). Call distribute_status first to list brands, then pass brandId (and orgId if a brand sits in several orgs). A user in a single organization can omit both.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID to get stats for

brandId.description: Brand to act on (from distribute_status). Selects the organization holding it. Required when your key reaches several organizations, unless orgId is given.

orgId.description: Organization to act in (from distribute_status). Add it when a brand sits in several organizations, or to act in an organization without naming a brand.

distribute_list_brands.description: List the brands (companies/websites you promote through campaigns) of the targeted organization. distribute_status already lists every organization with its brands; use this for the full brand records of the organization you target. Call distribute_status first to list brands, then pass brandId (and orgId if a brand sits in several orgs). A user in a single organization can omit both.

brandId.description: Brand to act on (from distribute_status). Selects the organization holding it. Required when your key reaches several organizations, unless orgId is given.

orgId.description: Organization to act in (from distribute_status). Add it when a brand sits in several organizations, or to act in an organization without naming a brand.

distribute_suggest_icp.description: Analyze a brand's website and suggest an Ideal Customer Profile (ICP). Use this when the user doesn't know who to target and wants AI-generated targeting suggestions. Returns a description of the ideal customers to aim a campaign at. Name the brand by brandId, or by brand_url (matched against the brands of the targeted organization). Call distribute_status first to list brands, then pass brandId (and orgId if a brand sits in several orgs). A user in a single organization can omit both.

brand_url.description: The brand/company URL to analyze for ICP extraction. Optional when brandId is given.

brandId.description: Brand to act on (from distribute_status). Selects the organization holding it. Required when your key reaches several organizations, unless orgId is given.

orgId.description: Organization to act in (from distribute_status). Add it when a brand sits in several organizations, or to act in an organization without naming a brand.

post.description: Handles MCP protocol requests. Use mcp-session-id header for session management.
